recordings.notes: Individual fugue track, excluding its prelude. Official Roberto Prosseda - Topic / Universal Music Group upload; recording credited to Universal Music Italia (2014), released in Mendelssohn: Complete Piano Works (2019). Live YouTube page metadata verified the full fugue title, performer and label; playback status OK and embedding allowed at check. The Structures diagram covers an exposition excerpt only. No bar or entry timing has been measured.

verification.method: Work, performer and recording metadata checked against public source pages; no musical timing or listening quality is asserted.

analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt ends after the four initial entries, at m. 10. The alto begins an eighth note later than a simple ten-beat entry grid would predict. The later chorale and all subsequent subject entries are outside this map. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
